banner.note: Single ID through 1.21.3 with pole, bar and flag in one model; 1.21.4 splits it into standing_banner and wall_banner. BannerRenderer.render (1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.3), standing path: translate(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), Y rotation, scale(2/3, -2/3, -2/3). Wall banners hide the pole and use translate(0.5, -1/6, 0.5), Y facing, translate(0, -0.3125, -0.4375) instead.
